findings.title: A timer-started Pre-Vote round survives leader establishment and deposes the new Leader
findings.scenario: U2: Pre-Vote round lifecycle vs real election and leadership
findings.summary: The election timer skips only Leaders, so a Candidate whose real election outlives the election timeout starts a Pre-Vote round for the next term (Engine::pre_elect). When the real election then wins, establish_leader -> update_vote -> become_leader does not drop Engine::pre_candidate. A delayed Pre-Vote grant passes RaftCore's filter (tracker present, same leader id) and Engine::handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() on quorum without any role check, so the freshly established Leader starts an election at term+1; followers holding its fresh lease reject that election, leaving the cluster leaderless until leases expire. Because elect() keeps the Leader object, RaftCore's next try_leader_handler fails debug_assert(leader.vote >= state.vote) and panics in debug builds. Reproduced by trace validation, an engine-level test, and two integration tests (operator-started and timer-only) on the updated revision.

findings.title: A delayed Pre-Vote grant from a node removed between two same-term rounds panics RaftCore
findings.scenario: U5: Frozen Pre-Vote quorum vs membership evolution (with U2)
findings.summary: Engine::pre_elect always probes (vote.term+1, self), so Pre-Vote rounds at an unchanged term share a leader id, and RaftCore's does_pre_candidate_vote_match compares only the leader id. A delayed grant to an earlier round is therefore counted in a later round. If a membership change removed the granter between the rounds, handle_pre_vote_resp calls Candidate::grant_by, which expects the granter to be in the round's frozen quorum set and panics ('target not in quorum set'), killing RaftCore also in release builds. BFS of MC_hunt_prevote_stale_grant_tight.cfg found a 17-state crash-free counterexample and TLC simulation of the complete MCNext found a 31-state one (timer round kept by a new Leader, Leader removes node 3, operator Trigger::elect(true) starts a same-term round, node 3's delayed grant arrives). Reproduced by two engine-level tests (leader and follower variants) and an integration test (follower variant) on the updated revision; a timer-only path is blocked by the Pre-Vote RPC timeout.
